segments.name: Residential real estate product and service offerings
segments.description: An e-commerce platform for residential real estate transactions that buys homes directly from sellers, resells them, and offers integrated title and escrow services.
segments.evidence: The operating segment is the Company's residential real estate product and service offerings.

revenueModel.text: Opendoor earns revenue primarily by reselling homes it buys from sellers, charging sellers a service fee, and charging buyers and sellers title, escrow and settlement fees.
revenueModel.evidence: For customers who sell directly to us, we charge a service fee.
